concern.description:
The fresh-training release constructs generation modules with default initialization instead of copying the loaded pretrained branch. Later trained-checkpoint loading can overwrite those values.

Impact assessment. Minor: the public fresh-training recipe differs from the specified initialization, but the historical trained models and core performance claims are not shown invalid.
